knowledge:
- key_parameters: convert_KEGG_IDs=Logical (default TRUE) to convert KEGG IDs to gene/compound symbols; setting to FALSE speeds up mapping ;; get_KOs=Logical (default FALSE) in path_genes_by_cell_type to return lists of specific gene knock-outs ;; keep_counts_only=Logical (default TRUE) in overlap_info; set to FALSE to include lists of concordant/discordant genes ;; only_mapped=Logical in add_edge_data to restrict appended data to edges hard-coded in the KGML file ;; data_column_no=Numeric vector in add_edge_data to specify which columns of user data to append to the edge dataset ;; data_added=Logical in edge_mapping_info; must be set to TRUE when user data has been added to edges ;; significance_markup=Logical in edge_mapping_info to format edges based on significance and direction of Fisher's Exact Test summary scores ;; refine_by_cell_line=Logical in KEGG_lincs to automatically prune pathway edges based on baseline expression data
- alternatives: SPIA (Signaling Pathway Impact Analysis) is mentioned as an analysis that uses the exact pathway topology generated here ;; KEGG_lincs_auto and cyto_vis_auto (available on GitHub) are mentioned as automated alternatives for Cytoscape rendering
- when_to_use: Use when you want to analyze and visualize detailed KEGG pathway topologies with resolved paralogs and grouped nodes, or when you want to overlay edge-specific experimental relationship data (like knock-out concordance) onto KEGG pathways.
- pitfalls: Cytoscape style inheritance: Graphs rendered in the same Cytoscape session inherit style elements (like conditional formatting ranges) from existing graphs; start a fresh Cytoscape session when mapping requires conditional formatting ;; ID conversion overhead: Converting KEGG IDs to symbols in expand_KEGG_mappings is computationally expensive; set convert_KEGG_IDs = FALSE for faster runs ;; Incomplete experimental data: L1000 knock-out and expression data are incomplete across cell lines; check coverage using path_genes_by_cell_type before comparing cell lines.

workflows.name: visualize_expanded_kegg_pathway
workflows.intent: Reconstruct and visualize detailed "expanded" KEGG pathways from KGML files without adding experimental data.
workflows.stages: 1. Download and parse KGML file using get_KGML ;; 2. Expand node mappings using expand_KEGG_mappings ;; 3. Expand edge mappings using expand_KEGG_edges ;; 4. Generate node and edge mapping info using node_mapping_info and edge_mapping_info ;; 5. Create an igraph object using get_graph_object ;; 6. Visualize in Cytoscape using cyto_vis (or use the master function KEGG_lincs)
workflows.code:
FoxO_KGML <- get_KGML("hsa04068")
slot(FoxO_KGML, "pathwayInfo")
slot(slot(FoxO_KGML, "pathwayInfo"), "image")
FoxO_KEGG_mappings <- expand_KEGG_mappings(FoxO_KGML)
FoxO_edges <- expand_KEGG_edges(FoxO_KGML, FoxO_KEGG_mappings)
length(graph::nodes(FoxO_KGML))
nrow(FoxO_KEGG_mappings)
length(graph::edges(FoxO_KGML))
nrow(FoxO_edges)
FoxO_node_mapping_info <- node_mapping_info(FoxO_KEGG_mappings)
FoxO_edge_mapping_info <- edge_mapping_info(FoxO_edges)
GO <- get_graph_object(FoxO_node_mapping_info, FoxO_edge_mapping_info)
class(GO)
cyto_vis(GO, "FoxO Pathway with Expanded Edges[no data added]")
KEGG_lincs("hsa04068")
FoxO_edges <- KEGG_lincs("hsa04068")
KEGG_lincs("hsa04068", convert_KEGG_IDs = FALSE)

workflows.name: overlay_experimental_edge_data
workflows.intent: Map experimental knock-out or edge-relation data onto expanded KEGG pathways to analyze and visualize cell-line specific pathway topology.
workflows.stages: 1. Download and parse KGML using get_KGML ;; 2. Expand node and edge mappings using expand_KEGG_mappings and expand_KEGG_edges ;; 3. Check pathway gene coverage across cell lines using path_genes_by_cell_type ;; 4. Extract overlap/edge data using overlap_info ;; 5. Append experimental data to edges using add_edge_data ;; 6. Generate node and edge mapping info with significance markup using node_mapping_info and edge_mapping_info ;; 7. Create an igraph object using get_graph_object ;; 8. Visualize the conditional-formatted network in Cytoscape using cyto_vis (or use the master function KEGG_lincs)
workflows.code:
KEGG_lincs("hsa04115")
p53_KGML <- get_KGML("hsa04115")
p53_KEGG_mappings <- expand_KEGG_mappings(p53_KGML)
p53_edges <- expand_KEGG_edges(p53_KGML, p53_KEGG_mappings)
path_genes_by_cell_type(p53_KEGG_mappings)
p53_L1000_summary <- path_genes_by_cell_type(p53_KEGG_mappings, get_KOs = TRUE, generate_plot = FALSE)
p53_PC3_data <- overlap_info(p53_KGML, p53_KEGG_mappings, "PC3")
p53_HA1E_data <- overlap_info(p53_KGML, p53_KEGG_mappings, "HA1E")
p53_PC3_data_with_gene_lists <- overlap_info(p53_KGML, p53_KEGG_mappings, "PC3", keep_counts_only = FALSE)
p53_PC3_edges <- add_edge_data(p53_edges, p53_KEGG_mappings, p53_PC3_data, only_mapped = TRUE, data_column_no = c(3,10,12))
p53_HA1E_edges <- add_edge_data(p53_edges, p53_KEGG_mappings, p53_HA1E_data, only_mapped = TRUE, data_column_no =  c(3,10,12))
p53_node_map <- node_mapping_info(p53_KEGG_mappings)
p53_edge_map_PC3 <- edge_mapping_info(p53_PC3_edges, data_added = TRUE, significance_markup = TRUE)
p53_edge_map_HA1E <- edge_mapping_info(p53_HA1E_edges, data_added = TRUE, significance_markup = TRUE)
PC3_GO <- get_graph_object(p53_node_map, p53_edge_map_PC3)
HA1E_GO <- get_graph_object(p53_node_map, p53_edge_map_HA1E)
cyto_vis(PC3_GO, "Pathway = p53, Cell line = PC3")
cyto_vis(HA1E_GO, "Pathway = p53, Cell line = HA1E")
KEGG_lincs("hsa04115", "PC3", refine_by_cell_line = FALSE)
KEGG_lincs("hsa04115", "HA1E", refine_by_cell_line = FALSE)
